basic_details.short_information: College of Agriculture, Mul, Dist. Chandrapur (Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth, Akola) has 2 posts of Contractual Assistant Professor, one in Agronomy and one for Physical Education Instructor, for a period of 11 months. Applications must be sent in hard copy by post, speed post or courier to the Associate Dean, College of Agriculture, Mul Distt-Chandrapur-441224, and must reach on or before 16 November 2026, up to 05.00 P.M. Applications received after that are not considered.

rows.details: College of Agriculture, Mul, Dist. Chandrapur (Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth, Akola)
Contractual Assistant Professor – Agronomy; Physical Education Instructor
Fixed emoluments of Rs. 45,000/- per month
Agronomy: M.Sc. Net or Ph.D; Physical Education Instructor: M.P.Ed., preferably NET/SET qualified or Ph.D
College of Agriculture, Mul, Distt-Chandrapur, Maharashtra
Post, speed post or courier (hard copy)

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go by post, speed post or courier to this address: Associate Dean, College of Agriculture, Mul Distt-Chandrapur-441224 Get the application format from the website www.pdkv.ac.in , on the recruitment tab. Fill the application in hard copy on A4 size paper only, in the given format. Sign the form with your original signature and affix a recent photograph in the designated space. Attach self-attested photo copies of your documents (listed under Enclosures). Send it by post, speed post or courier so that it reaches the Associate Dean on or before 16 November 2026, up to 05.00 P.M. A form without the original signature and a recent photograph is rejected without further correspondence. The notice does not mention any wording to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: M.Sc. Net or Ph.D Essential qualification: M.P.Ed., preferably NET/SET qualified or Ph.D The notice gives no age limit and no experience requirement for either post; an experience certificate is to be enclosed only if the candidate has one. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.post: Contractual Assistant Professor – Physical Education Instructor

content_sections.heading: COA Mul Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints one job description for both Contractual Assistant Professor posts: Teach the respective course. Conduct the midterms, end theory and practical examination. Evaluate answer books. Submit results. Do office related work for 11 months.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Candidates should submit and bring self-attested copies of all documents pertaining to: Original copies of all required and claimed documents must be shown at the personal interview and again before joining.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The applications are scrutinised first, and only shortlisted candidates are called for a personal interview in a 1:5 ratio. The interview date, place and time will be communicated to eligible candidates, and a notice for the interview will also be published on the university website. Interviews will probably be held in the last week of November 2026. The interview will be in offline mode at College of Agriculture, Mul Distt-Chandrapur.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in COA Mul Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 Contractual Assistant Professor posts: 01 in Agronomy and 01 for Physical Education Instructor.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Associate Dean, College of Agriculture, Mul on or before 16 November 2026, up to 05.00 P.M.; applications received later are not considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Agronomy post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification for the Agronomy post is M.Sc. Net or Ph.D.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Physical Education Instructor post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is M.P.Ed., preferably NET/SET qualified or Ph.D.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Contractual Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Both posts carry fixed emoluments of Rs. 45,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the application format from www.pdkv.ac.in (recruitment tab) in hard copy on A4 paper, attach self-attested document copies, and send it by post, speed post or courier to the Associate Dean, College of Agriculture, Mul Distt-Chandrapur-441224.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: After scrutiny of applications, shortlisted candidates are called for an offline personal interview in a 1:5 ratio at College of Agriculture, Mul Distt-Chandrapur.

faq.question: Q8. When will the interview be held?
faq.answer: Interviews will probably be held in the last week of November 2026; the exact date, place and time will be communicated to eligible candidates and published on the university website.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary on contract for 11 months, with no claim for regular appointment under Dr. PDKV, Akola.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA or accommodation be given for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the interview and no accommodation will be provided.
